title: Loading rail cars from Hatfield Industries
description: In the early 1950s, Hatfield Industries loaded boxes of potato chips into boxcars. Owner Heber Hatfield was known for his remarkable memory. He would stroll along the line of railway cars beside his office, memorizing each car number. Back in his office, he would recite the numbers in exact order to his secretary. Some numbers were as long as ten digits, and there were often more than a dozen cars to remember. (Photo courtesy of Barb Nicholson Layte)
